expectations.text: Recommends sparse MaxDiff (not full design with 75 items)
expectations.evidence: Correctly identifies the sparse design problem and recommends sparse incomplete block design.

expectations.text: Specifies items-per-respondent-subset, showings-per-item, and sets-per-respondent with actual numbers
expectations.evidence: 18 tasks, 5 items/set, ~1.2 showings/item specified. Note: 1.2 showings/item is well below the 3-showing HB floor, but numbers are technically present.

expectations.text: Discusses co-occurrence balance across the population
expectations.evidence: 'Check orthogonality: Items should co-appear with each other approximately equally often.'

expectations.text: Gives sample size in the 500-1500 range with reasoning (not just a rule-of-thumb)
expectations.evidence: Recommends 300-400 for aggregate, 400-500 for HB. Both below 500. Reasoning is observation-count based, not SE/precision-derived.

expectations.text: Notes individual-level readout degrades at k=75 and recommends aggregate or segment-level
expectations.evidence: 'With 75 items and only ~18 tasks per respondent, individual estimates will be relatively imprecise' and HB relies heavily on group prior.

suggestions.reason: Assertion 2 passes despite 1.2 showings/item - well below HB floor of 3. Consider requiring showings-per-item >= 3.

eval_feedback.overall: Sample size is the key discriminating assertion. Baseline falls below 500 floor.
